headline: Small but prime-angle SSE and glassy at dawn — grab the log before the sea breeze.
today: Prime angle at Lido but only pushing 2ft at 6.4s, so it's a morning-glass log session and nothing more. Dawn and morning are dead light with a NW touch, so surf it around the 9:22 high before the SW cross-on kicks in by afternoon. Fun for a longboard, skip it if you need real waves.

daysToWatch.note: Up to 5ft on the reading but morning and afternoon are hammered by 16-22mph cross-on. The 6mph NNE offshore in the evening could clean up leftovers — that's the only window worth chasing.
Chest-high SSE at a good angle with NNE/NE cross-off dawn and morning. Best conditions of the week here — surf it early before the evening onshore.
